description: Create column PARK_ID at index 2 based on column PARK_NAME using expression grel:value.replace('É', 'E').replace("'", '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/, ' ').trim().toTitlecase().replace(' ', '_')

expression: grel:with(filter(cross(cells.PARK_ID.value, '', 'PARK_ID'), r, r.cells.FACILITY_NAME.value == cells.FACILITY_NAME.value), same, cells.PARK_ID.value + '_' + cells.FACILITY_NAME.value.replace("'", '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/, ' ').trim().toTitlecase().replace(' ', '_') + if(same.length() > 1, '_' + (filter(same, r, r.cells.FACILITY_ID.value.toNumber() < value.toNumber()).length() + 1), ''))
